scorecard: Management’s FY27 targets are largely untested; the few testable metrics (revenue growth, ROA) are on track, but many promises lack data and some targets were raised later, limiting credibility.
business: Bajaj Finance Ltd is a non‑bank financial company offering consumer loans, SME financing and other credit products. It reported AUM growth of 26.5% to ₹5,84,624 crore and added 4.5 million new customers in Q2 FY27.
bull: Revenue grew 23% YoY in Q2 FY27, beating prior quarters
EBITDA margin rose to 36% in Q2 FY27, above FY26 33% level
ROA hit 4.6% in Q2 FY27, matching top of FY27 guidance
bear: Cash flow remains negative, FY26 CFO –₹65,790 cr, indicating funding pressure
GNPA target <₹1,500 cr lacks disclosed progress, raising credit risk concerns
Fee‑income growth target 15‑18% cannot be verified without segment data
